preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
The number of points N in each test case must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= x_i <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= y_i <= 10**9 for x_i, y_i in points)
preconditions.description: Each point's coordinates must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.
The integer c must be a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of checkpoints and the minimum number of moves.
The number of checkpoints must be at least 1.
The number of moves must be non-negative.
